violated_contract: A failed mutation must tell the operator why it failed through a channel that is actually rendered. web/admin shipped the whole toast stack (hooks/use-toast.ts, components/ui/toast.tsx, @radix-ui/react-toast) and eight useToast() call sites across team, organizations, distributors and popular-apps, but no component ever rendered ToastProvider/ToastViewport, so every toast(...) in the dashboard queued into state nothing subscribed to. Adding a person on /dashboard/team returned 404 four times in five seconds and the owner saw no error, no success and no change: the feature looked dead rather than refused.
canonical_prevention: The component that renders a queued-notification hook is mounted once at the root layout, beside the providers the hook depends on, so a call site cannot be wired to a hook whose renderer is absent; a route that a dialog surfaces is covered by tests asserting the status and response shape the dialog renders, so the message the operator sees is pinned to the outcome the server chose.
